# Nick Nikolaev

> Full-stack web engineer. Builds marketing CMS, infrastructure, and growth stack so marketing teams can ship without waiting on engineering.

This is a personal site, not a product or an API. The public name is Nick Nikolaev (Nikolay Nikolaev). Available for new projects. Book a 30-minute call or email — no pitch; the call is a look at the current setup and a short list of next steps.

Four systems he ships with: marketing systems (WordPress, Shopify, custom CMS), infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, Cloudflare), applied AI (integrations and agentic workflows), and growth engineering (SEO, GEO / AI search, A/B testing, analytics).

## Site

- [Home](https://nikolaynikolaev.com/index.md): The whole site — clients, how I ship, case studies, and contact.

## Case studies

- [Yotpo](https://yotpo.com/): Block-based Gutenberg page builder and AI content workflows on a high-traffic WordPress marketing site, with AWS caching and security.
- [Ultimate Poker Coaching](https://ultimatepokercoaching.com/): WordPress coaching marketplace with Stripe payments, scheduling, and Cloudflare delivery.
- [Sensity AI](https://sensity.ai/): Multilingual marketing site for an AI-security / deepfake-detection company, built for SEO and marketing self-serve.
- [Hermes plugin](https://nikolaynikolaev.com/#projects): Shared WordPress plugin (Gutenberg blocks, third-party APIs, tracking) used across several high-traffic iGaming media sites.
